addons.name: Auctionator
addons.notes: A lightweight addon that makes it easy and fast to buy, sell and manage auctions
addons.title: Auctionator

addons.name: ClassicFishingCompanion
addons.notes: Track your fishing catches, fish per hour, locations, and statistics. Forever support is for testing on the Forever beta; fixes will follow.
addons.title: Classic Fishing Companion (Forever Beta)

addons.name: ForeverDungeonJournal
addons.notes: Boss, loot and quest journal for WoW Classic dungeons.
addons.title: Dungeon Journal

addons.name: ForeverDump
addons.notes: Dumps WoW Forever client API, docs, widgets, templates, CVars, fixtures and event recordings to SavedVariables for offline addon development.
addons.title: ForeverDump

addons.name: idTip
addons.notes: Adds various IDs to tooltips (WoW Forever port of silverwind's idTip)
addons.title: idTip

addons.name: QuestLevelPatch
addons.notes: Adds level within brackets to the quest name. Example: [62] Order Must Be Restored
addons.title: QuestLevelPatch

addons.name: TomTom
addons.notes: Acts as your portable navigation assistant
addons.title: TomTom

addons.name: TweaksForever
addons.notes: Small quality-of-life automations and fixes that extend the default UI, stepping aside where another addon already does the job.
addons.title: Tweaks Forever

addons.name: LibAHTab
addons.notes: Keeps Auctionator tabs compatible with native auction house panels.
addons.title: Tweaks Forever: Auction House compatibility
